purpose.zh: 练上背，让肩膀活动更顺
purpose.en: Strengthen your upper back and help your shoulders move freely.

text.zh: 胸口微抬，伸直的手臂从头顶划到髋旁
text.en: Keep your chest slightly lifted and sweep straight arms from overhead to your hips

text.zh: 趴着，双腿伸直，手臂离地悬空。
text.en: Lie face down, legs long, arms hovering just off the floor.

text.zh: 划到髋旁时掌心朝上，再划回头顶。
text.en: Turn your palms up at your hips, then sweep back overhead.

commonErrors.en: Arching your lower back to lift too high.

cautions.zh: 腰或肩膀疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back or shoulders hurt, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 节奏按 spec 头注释：下划 1.5 / 髋旁停 0.5 / 划回 1.5 / 头顶停 0.5 s；停顿 < 0.8 s 用 rep_updown
peak 口令「停住」改「掌心朝上」（动画到髋旁翻掌）；cautions 改短句
flags: 批表 hold 1.13 偏大（把接近顶点的慢速段算进去），按 spec 手算
